method: APPROXIMATION: characters of the JSON tool list / 4 (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was set, so Anthropic's count_tokens was not called)
notes: Only the tool definitions are counted (what sits in the context on every turn). Code Mode then spends tokens per task: a search call and its spec fragments, and the execute plan and its selected result.

The two-tool list is fixed in size; the per-endpoint list grows with each endpoint, so the saving grows with the number of endpoints. This server has only 10 read endpoints, so the saving here is small.
Cloudflare's figure of about 1,000 tokens for Code Mode is about their own API (2,500+ endpoints), not this one.
